title: JANUS UAP Domain Index — 2026-08-14
purpose: Provide a discoverable read map for the JANUS UAP, nuclear-context and POSS-I transient research lineage without rewriting historical artifacts or promoting a new open result to canonical authority.

authority_boundary.reason: The independent public POSS-I reconstruction now has a real result, but it is a transport test on a non-byte-equivalent open cohort and longer-window structure still requires sky-position/artifact controls. Navigation may point to it as active research head without promoting it to canonical authority.

POSS1_TRANSIENTS_NUCLEAR_UAP_CORRELATION.current_result: The independent fully public cohort does not reproduce a positive nuclear-test enhancement in the preregistered +/-1-day window or on the exact day after a test. Wider negative structure is noncausal/unresolved because pre-event lags and schedule-preserving diagnostics indicate remaining temporal/sky-field confounding.

OPEN_POSS1_REPRODUCIBILITY.open_cohort: 122,820 public candidates / 31,458 processed tiles / 642 plates; 640 plates and 122,511 candidates fall inside the target study interval.
OPEN_POSS1_REPRODUCIBILITY.important_boundary: This cohort is independently selected and fully public. It is not a silent substitute claimed to be byte-identical to the unavailable 107,875-source VASCO catalog.

LEGACY_UAP_META.important_note: Legacy confidence labels and Galileo/AARO wording must be read through the 2026 corrective audits; unresolved and ambiguous observations are not automatically anomalous.

CONUS_NUCLEAR_SITE_UAP_SPATIAL_ANALYSIS.required_next_control: Recode provenance and outcome semantics so OBSERVATION_VERIFIED, IDENTITY_RESOLVED, KINEMATICS_VALIDATED, ANOMALOUS_PERFORMANCE_VALIDATED and ORIGIN_VALIDATED are distinct.

HISTORICAL_CLOSED_SAMPLE_REPRODUCIBILITY.blocker: Exact closed 107,875-source VASCO bytes remain unavailable. This no longer blocks the independent public transport test, but it still blocks byte-exact replication of that historical sample.

NUCLEAR_UAP_EMULATION_AND_NULLS.role: Synthetic pseudo-event and false-positive controls; simulation outputs cannot establish real-world UAP or nuclear causation by themselves.

CROSS_DOMAIN_COSMOLOGY_AND_FALLOUT_ANALO.hard_boundary: UAP/nuclear correlations may inform an observational layer but cannot be upgraded into proof of Many-Worlds branching, new classical universes, Fallout doctrine, or non-human agency.

next_read_order_for_execution: 1. Read the open public reconstruction result and its claim ceiling.
2. Read the open cohort design to understand source independence, WCS repairs and tile-minute exposure semantics.
3. Treat the request-only 107,875 catalog as an optional exact-replication branch, not a blocker for further open research.
4. Freeze the next sky-position/field-density control before inspecting its effect on the longer-window negative structure.
5. Replace tile-minute proxy with exact valid WCS footprint area-time exposure and add artifact/environmental strata.
6. Only after those controls may any residual wider-window association be reconsidered for admission.
integrity_rules: This file is navigation, not evidence.
Historical JSONs remain byte/provenance records and are not silently rewritten by this index.
A public non-equivalent catalog may test transport but may not be called an exact replication of a closed catalog.
A significant pre-event lag is a confounding warning, not evidence for backwards nuclear causation.
A negative wider-window coefficient may not be promoted to nuclear suppression until sky-position, footprint and artifact controls survive.
Any future current-authority pointer must target an explicitly admitted canonical artifact, not merely the most recent research head.
